values.primary_criterion_sentence: Both fine-grid lower bounds exceed zero, meeting the prespecified mutual-benefit criterion within this model.
values.school_signs_and_joint_counts: 14 positive, one unchanged and one negative dolphin school mean; 14 positive and two negative gannet means; joint gains in 12 of 16 schools
values.coarse_gain_CIs: +0.471 [0.286, 0.657] fish per dolphin and +0.188 [0.073, 0.304] per gannet
values.grid_interpretation_sentence: Both grids show positive mean partner gains, but paired-grid intervals include differences in either direction and do not demonstrate numerical convergence.
values.numerical_limit_sentence: Support at H1/G36 does not validate every discovery setting, calibrate physical units or establish numerical convergence.
values.validation_discussion_sentence: The independent sixteen-school study supports mutual feeding benefits at fixed H1/G36: both prespecified fine-grid intervals lie above zero. This strengthens the result beyond the outcome-selected four-school map, while school and labelled-world losses remain.
values.software_reproduction_status: Default Run All reconstructs nine discovery/population tables and four validation tables, loads archived Figure 1 and redraws Figures 2–4 from the separately verified evidence and saved interval endpoints.
